call_glm46v_processor: call the Glm46VProcessor with images, text, and videos to produce tokenized inputs with pixel values and attention masks
create_mm_token_type_ids: create multimodal token type ids that distinguish image tokens from video tokens in input ids
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of multimodal tokens for given image and video sizes
post_process_image_text_to_text: post-process generated model outputs by decoding tensors into readable text strings
build_glm46v_processor: build a Glm46VProcessor instance with image_processor, tokenizer, and optional video_processor for multimodal text generation
